changelog: EMERGENCY FIX: 'Hangs on main screen, gets kicked out' boot loop. Field telemetry on v142 showed BOOT::app_oc_post_main_resilience reports climbing (the exact boot-loop signature v140 was meant to permanently fix). The looper resilience wrapper that was re-enabled in v141 has been re-disabled for canada and official permanently — it's now gated dev-only. The wrapper re-enters Looper.loop() from a Handler.post(), which evidently breaks something subtle in the Android TV boot path on certain devices. Re-throwing bare framework exceptions is the safer call; the crash handler still uploads traces for diagnosis. KEEPING all the genuinely-helpful fixes: v141's safeFocusTraversal migration (fixes the #1 Java crash) and v142's deferred prewarm (fixes the 6.6-sec boot stall on 1 GB Fire Stick Lites).
INHERITED v1.44.142: DevBundleCache.prewarm() relocated out of the boot-critical path (skipped on Lite-mode devices, deferred 5 sec post-first-frame on Pro devices).
INHERITED v1.44.141: FocusRequester crash fix via safeFocusTraversal across player + browse screens.
INHERITED v1.44.140: OkHttp xtream_http_cache no longer deleted on 6h auto cache-clear + KidsContentFilter regex stripped of adult brand-name string literals (Play Protect harmful-app fix).
